reasons: Deterministic minimality check fails on p0012 (changed-character ratio 0.788): the second operation appends an entirely new sentence that roughly doubles the paragraph, so the edit is not minimal for a rule whose redline guidance is simply to delete the Customer-payable LD (or cap an unavoidable termination fee).

The appended sentence is largely redundant of the first operation — once the take-or-pay mechanic and the 'without reduction or termination rights' language are struck and the figure is recast as a non-binding target, no shortfall, penalty or loss of termination rights survives in this clause.

The added language is also over-broad for its location: a blanket statement in Section 2.1 that Customer 'is not liable for any ... liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination charge' and that all reduction/non-renewal/termination rights are 'unaffected' operates agreement-wide, reaching clauses outside the cited paragraph and inconsistently with the fallback (a 3-month early-termination fee) that the comment itself offers.

Recommended minimal fix: keep only operation 1 — strike 'on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights' and soften 'commits to purchase' to a non-binding target (or, in the alternative, cap any shortfall/termination amount at three months' Fees) — and leave the blanket waiver to the comment.

Classification direction is otherwise sound: the obligation runs against Customer and a non-terminable minimum spend functions as a Customer-payable minimum/termination amount within the rule's detection guidance, and Customer-facing remedies and service credits were correctly left alone.
